scope: All 13 Genshin Impact editions plus 3 others: 16 editions, 144 standard action rows. Read-only published assets.
method: Actually viewed all 16 labelled contact sheets; opened native PNG rows for each candidate class and all retained decoded source images referenced below. Static visual inspection plus cell bounds; no new visuals generated, no runtime playback claimed.
timing_context: Parent verified current client repeats actions three times; proposed maps require actual durations_ms three-cycle QA before release.
severity_policy: major/moderate identify visible geometric/sequence problems; minor candidates must demonstrate enough native benefit to justify change. Numerical seam ratio alone never establishes a defect.

rows.issue: Large-scale seated/crouched poses mix with standing poses and the last frame turns fully away before resetting to front, creating visible pose and size jumps.

rows.rationale: Three standing attentive/request poses retain state meaning and allow recovery, with holds rather than added artwork. Verify that the gesture does not become distracting back-and-forth waving.

rows.issue: Working row alternates standing/kneeling and switches between a board, book, blank hands and another book; native frames do not form one coherent motion.
rows.rationale: Reordering cannot remove prop and torso discontinuities while retaining a useful work gesture; generate a complete consistent working row only if approved within main task scope.
